results.title: Home page loads with primary navigation
results.steps: Open /
results.expected: Landing page renders with Home / Employees / About navigation
results.actual: Home page rendered; title='Home - EAEmployee'; nav present

results.title: Employee list renders with record count
results.steps: Open /Employee
results.expected: Table of employees plus a total count
results.actual: 281 employees reported, 5 rows on page 1

results.title: Search by an existing employee name
results.steps: Search the first listed name
results.expected: That employee's row is returned
results.actual: search 'BOyd' -> row returned (gruity@gmail.com)

results.title: Search is case-insensitive
results.steps: Search the same name with flipped case
results.expected: The same row is returned
results.actual: 'boYD' matched 'BOyd' — search is case-insensitive

results.title: No-match search shows an empty state
results.steps: Search ZZZ_NO_MATCH_ZZZ
results.expected: 'No employees found.' message
results.actual: empty state shown: 'No employees found.'

results.title: Filter the list by Grade
results.steps: Select Grade=Junior and submit the search form
results.expected: Only Junior employees are listed and the dropdown keeps the selection
results.actual: only Junior rows returned (5 rows)

results.title: Login with empty credentials is rejected
results.steps: Submit /Account/Login with both fields blank
results.expected: Required-field validation on both fields
results.actual: both fields flagged required

results.title: Login with a wrong password is rejected
results.steps: Submit admin / wrongpass123
results.expected: 'Invalid login attempt.'
results.actual: 'Invalid login attempt.' shown

results.title: Login with valid admin credentials
results.steps: Submit admin / password
results.expected: Authenticated; admin-only actions become visible
results.actual: authenticated as admin; New Employee / Edit / Delete visible

results.title: Anonymous user cannot reach admin screens
results.steps: Open /Employee and /Employee/Create in a clean session
results.expected: No admin actions on the list; /Employee/Create redirects to login
results.actual: anonymous user sees read-only list; /Employee/Create redirects to login

results.title: Register a new user account
results.steps: Submit /Account/Register with a unique username, email and valid password
results.expected: Account is created without error
results.actual: registered 'qauser20260806075829' and was signed in automatically

results.title: Create form validates required fields
results.steps: Submit /Employee/Create empty
results.expected: Every required field is flagged
results.actual: required-field validation fired on empty submit

results.title: Create form validates email format
results.steps: Submit the create form with Email=not-an-email
results.expected: Email format error is shown
results.actual: email format rejected: 'The Email field is not a valid e-mail address.'

results.title: Create a valid employee record
results.steps: Fill every field with valid data and submit
results.expected: Record is saved with the exact values and appears in the list
results.actual: created 'QA Regression 20260806075843' (id 520), all values stored correctly

results.title: Details view shows the record's data
results.steps: Open Details for the created employee
results.expected: Name, salary, grade and duration are shown
results.actual: details page (/EmployeeDetails/Index/520) shows the selected employee

results.title: Update an existing employee
results.steps: Edit the created employee: salary 75000→82000, grade Senior→C-Level, save
results.expected: Changes are persisted and visible in the list
results.actual: edit persisted: salary $82,000.00, grade C-Level

results.title: Delete an employee
results.steps: Delete the created employee and confirm
results.expected: Record is removed from the list
results.actual: 'QA Regression 20260806075843' removed; no longer returned by search

results.title: Dashboard renders metrics
results.steps: Open /Dashboard as admin
results.expected: Dashboard renders with employee metrics
results.actual: dashboard rendered with metrics (sample: ['281', '$38,922', '31', '3', '$10,937,034', '5'])

results.title: PF contribution total matches its own formula
results.steps: Open an employee's PF Contribution page
results.expected: Total equals 12% × monthly salary × months worked
results.actual: PF total ₹183.6 == 12% × 51.0 × 30 months (employee 79)

results.title: Company contribution matches its printed formula
results.steps: Open the same employee's Company Contribution page
results.expected: Total equals the PF% + grade-allowance formula shown on the page
results.actual: company contribution ₹278.46 contradicts the formula printed on the same page (PF 15% + 3×2% = 21% × 51.0 × 30 months = 321.3); the value implies an effective rate of 18.2%

results.title: Salary currency symbol is consistent across screens
results.steps: Compare the currency symbol on /Employee and /EmployeeDetails
results.expected: The same salary field uses one currency symbol everywhere
results.actual: salary is rendered as $ on the employee list but $/₹ on the details/PF screens — same field, two currencies

results.title: Deep pagination returns different rows
results.steps: From /Employee go to page 3 (or Next)
results.expected: A distinct set of rows loads
results.actual: deep page loaded distinct rows (https://eaapp.somee.com/Employee?page=3); Showing 11–15 of 281

results.title: Last page and out-of-range page behave sanely
results.steps: Open the last page, then a page number far beyond it
results.expected: Last page has rows; out-of-range clamps or empties without an error page
results.actual: page=57 rendered 1 rows; out-of-range page=557 handled gracefully (1 rows, no error page)

results.title: Employee list at a 390px mobile viewport
results.steps: Open /Employee at 390×844
results.expected: No horizontal overflow of the document
results.actual: no horizontal overflow at 390px (doc 390px / win 390px)

results.title: Non-existent record id is handled
results.steps: Open /Employee/Details/99999999
results.expected: Handled 404/redirect with no framework internals leaked
results.actual: HTTP 404 with an empty body — correct status, no branded error page
notes: 404 responses have an empty body (no styled 'not found' page), so a browser shows its own network-error screen instead of the app's UI

results.title: Plain registered user sees no admin actions
results.steps: Register a new user, sign in, open /Employee
results.expected: Create / Edit / Delete actions are hidden from non-admin users
results.actual: non-admin 'qarole0759338221' sees a read-only list (no admin actions)

results.title: Non-admin cannot open the create form
results.steps: As the registered non-admin user, open /Employee/Create
results.expected: Access is denied or redirected, not the form
results.actual: /Employee/Create is not served to the non-admin account (https://eaapp.somee.com/Account/AccessDenied?ReturnUrl=%2FEmployee%2FCreate)

results.title: Non-admin cannot persist a new employee
results.steps: As the non-admin user, submit the create form
results.expected: The write is rejected; no record is created
results.actual: non-admin cannot even load the create form, so no write was attempted

results.title: Non-admin cannot delete an employee
results.steps: Seed a record as admin, then open/submit its Delete page as the non-admin user
results.expected: The destructive action is refused for non-admins
results.actual: /Employee/Delete/521 is not served to the non-admin account

results.title: Unauthenticated POST cannot create data
results.steps: POST employee fields to /Employee/Create with no session
results.expected: Request is rejected (redirect/401/403) and nothing is stored
results.actual: unauthenticated POST rejected (HTTP 200); no record created

results.title: Dashboard is not exposed anonymously
results.steps: Request /Home/Dashboard with no session
results.expected: Anonymous visitors cannot read aggregate payroll metrics
results.actual: the management dashboard and its aggregate salary figures render for an anonymous visitor (HTTP 200, landed on https://eaapp.somee.com/Home/Dashboard)

results.title: Account management requires a session
results.steps: Request /Manage with no session
results.expected: Redirect to login or 401/403
results.actual: /Manage requires authentication (HTTP 200 -> https://eaapp.somee.com/Account/Login?ReturnUrl=%2FManage)

results.title: Authentication cookie carries HttpOnly/Secure/SameSite
results.steps: Sign in as admin and inspect the auth cookie flags
results.expected: Cookie is HttpOnly, Secure and SameSite-scoped
results.actual: auth cookie '.AspNetCore.Identity.Application' is HttpOnly + Secure + SameSite=Lax

results.title: Session identifier is rotated at login
results.steps: Capture cookies before and after signing in
results.expected: A pre-auth session id is not reused after authentication
results.actual: a new authentication cookie is issued at login; pre-login cookies: ['.AspNetCore.Antiforgery.O3pC8n4UgXo'] -> post-login: ['.AspNetCore.Antiforgery.O3pC8n4UgXo', '.AspNetCore.Identity.Application', '.AspNetCore.Session', 'b']

results.title: Logout invalidates the session server-side
results.steps: Capture the auth cookie, log out, replay the cookie in a clean browser
results.expected: The replayed cookie no longer reaches admin screens
results.actual: the authentication cookie still grants access to the admin create form after logout — signing out does not invalidate the session server-side

results.title: Authenticated pages are not cacheable
results.steps: Inspect Cache-Control on /Employee/Create while signed in
results.expected: no-store/no-cache so back-button cannot resurface private data
results.actual: authenticated pages send Cache-Control: no-cache, no-store

results.title: Baseline browser security headers
results.steps: Inspect response headers on /Employee
results.expected: X-Content-Type-Options, frame/CSP, HSTS and Referrer-Policy present
results.actual: responses carry none of the standard browser-hardening headers — missing: x-content-type-options (MIME-sniffing protection); x-frame-options / content-security-policy (clickjacking protection); strict-transport-security (HTTPS enforcement (HSTS)); referrer-policy (referrer leakage control); content-security-policy (content injection control)

results.title: No server/framework version disclosure
results.steps: Inspect Server / X-Powered-By / X-AspNet-Version headers
results.expected: The stack and its versions are not advertised
results.actual: the server advertises its stack in response headers: server: Microsoft-IIS/10.0, x-powered-by: ASP.NET — version disclosure helps an attacker target known CVEs

results.title: Plain HTTP is redirected to HTTPS
results.steps: Request the site over http://
results.expected: Redirected to the https:// origin
results.actual: plain HTTP is redirected to HTTPS (https://eaapp.somee.com/Employee)

results.title: Anti-forgery token is present and enforced
results.steps: Check the create form for a token, then POST without one
results.expected: Token present; token-less POST is rejected and stores nothing
results.actual: anti-forgery token present and enforced (token-less POST -> HTTP 400, nothing stored)

results.title: Login does not disclose whether a username exists
results.steps: Compare responses for an unknown user vs a wrong password
results.expected: Both produce the same generic message
results.actual: identical rejection for unknown user and wrong password ('invalid login attempt.')

results.title: Repeated failed logins are throttled or locked out
results.steps: Submit six wrong passwords for admin, then the correct one
results.expected: Lockout, throttling or CAPTCHA engages
results.actual: six consecutive failed logins for the admin account triggered no lockout, throttling or CAPTCHA, and the account remained usable immediately after — credential stuffing is unthrottled

results.title: Registration enforces a password policy
results.steps: Register with the password '1'
results.expected: The weak password is rejected
results.actual: a one-character password is rejected by the registration policy

results.title: Usernames are unique
results.steps: Register the same username twice
results.expected: The second attempt is rejected
results.actual: duplicate username 'qarole0759338221' rejected by registration

results.title: SQL tautology in the search box
results.steps: Search for ' OR '1'='1
results.expected: Treated as literal text; no DB error, no full dump
results.actual: SQL tautology treated as literal text (1 rows, no DB error) — parameterised query

results.title: Quote/wildcard/terminator payloads in search
results.steps: Search O'Brien, %, _, 1;DROP TABLE Employee--
results.expected: All handled as literals with no SQL exception page
results.actual: quote, wildcard and statement-terminator payloads all handled as literals

results.title: Reflected XSS via the search parameter
results.steps: Load /Employee?searchTerm=<script>…</script>
results.expected: Payload is HTML-encoded and never executes
results.actual: the search term is HTML-encoded when echoed back; no script execution

results.title: Stored XSS via the employee name field
results.steps: Save an employee whose name contains a script payload, then open the list
results.expected: Payload is encoded on render and never executes
results.actual: script payload stored as text and HTML-encoded on render; no execution

results.title: Malformed and out-of-range identifiers
results.steps: Probe six non-numeric/negative/huge ids across detail routes
results.expected: Handled 400/404 responses, never a 5xx
results.actual: all 6 malformed/out-of-range id probes handled without a 5xx

results.title: Over-long field input
results.steps: Save an employee with a 600-character name
results.expected: Rejected by validation or stored safely, never a server crash
results.actual: 600-char name accepted and stored (608 chars rendered) — no server-side maximum length on Name
notes: Name has no maximum-length validation: a 600-character value is stored and rendered into the list layout

results.title: Negative salary is rejected
results.steps: Save an employee with salary -50000
results.expected: Range validation refuses the value
results.actual: negative salary rejected by validation

results.title: Age accepts only a plausible range
results.steps: Save employees aged -5, 0 and 500
results.expected: All three are rejected
results.actual: negative, zero and 500-year ages are all rejected

results.title: Non-numeric salary is rejected
results.steps: Save an employee with salary 'not-a-number'
results.expected: Type validation refuses the value
results.actual: non-numeric salary rejected server-side (HTTP 400); the field is also client-guarded as input type='number'

results.title: Whitespace-only name is rejected
results.steps: Save an employee named '   '
results.expected: Required-field validation refuses it
results.actual: whitespace-only name rejected as required

results.title: Unicode names round-trip
results.steps: Save and re-read a name with accents and CJK characters
results.expected: The stored value is byte-identical on render
results.actual: unicode name round-trips intact ('QA Ünïcode 测试 0801365459')

results.title: Decimal salary precision
results.steps: Save salary 1234.56 and re-read it
results.expected: Value is preserved or cleanly rejected
results.actual: decimal salary preserved as $1,234.56

results.title: Duplicate employee email
results.steps: Create two employees with the same email address
results.expected: Either rejected, or allowed by design with no downstream ambiguity
results.actual: a duplicate employee email is rejected

results.title: Grade filter is correct for all four grades
results.steps: Filter the list by Junior, Middle, Senior and C-Level in turn
results.expected: Each filter returns only that grade and keeps the selection
results.actual: all four grades filter correctly and the dropdown keeps the selection

results.title: Email filter matches on the email column
results.steps: Filter by a fragment of an existing email
results.expected: Only rows containing the fragment come back
results.actual: email filter 'gruity' returned 1 matching rows

results.title: Name and grade filters combine (AND)
results.steps: Search a name token with Grade=Senior
results.expected: Only rows satisfying both criteria are returned
results.actual: name + grade filters combine correctly (1 rows for 'BOyd' + Senior)

results.title: Dashboard total agrees with the employee list
results.steps: Compare the list's record count with the dashboard metrics
results.expected: The two screens report the same population
results.actual: dashboard total agrees with the list count (282)

results.title: Editing one field leaves the others untouched
results.steps: Change only Salary on a seeded record and re-read every field
results.expected: Only Salary changes
results.actual: editing Salary changed only Salary; all other fields unchanged

results.title: Delete confirmation is accurate and cancellable
results.steps: Open Delete for a seeded record, verify it names the record, then navigate away
results.expected: The record is named and survives a cancel
results.actual: the confirmation page names the record and cancelling leaves it intact

results.title: PF formula holds for a controlled record
results.steps: Seed salary 120000 / 10 months and open its PF page
results.expected: Total equals 12% × monthly salary × months
results.actual: PF formula holds for a second, controlled record (₹144000.0 = 12% × 120000.0 × 10)

results.title: Pages do not overlap and the counter is consistent
results.steps: Walk pages 1–3 and compare the row sets and the 'Showing X–Y of Z' counter
results.expected: No row appears twice; the counter is coherent
results.actual: 3 pages walked, 15 distinct rows, no overlap; counter 'Showing 11–15 of 281' consistent

results.title: Key pages respond within 3s
results.steps: Time the home, list, login, register and details screens
results.expected: Every page is under the 3s budget
results.actual: all key pages responded within 3s: / 0.05s, /Employee 0.05s, /Account/Login 0.05s, /Account/Register 0.05s, /EmployeeDetails 0.21s

results.title: No broken internal links
results.steps: Collect and request every internal link on the main screens
results.expected: All resolve with a status below 400
results.actual: all 74 internal links on the main screens resolve (<400)

results.title: Static assets are cacheable
results.steps: Inspect cache headers on CSS/JS/image assets
results.expected: max-age, ETag or Last-Modified present
results.actual: static assets carry cache/validation headers (7 checked)

results.title: Responses are compressed
results.steps: Request /Employee with Accept-Encoding: gzip, br
results.expected: Content-Encoding is applied
results.actual: the employee list is served uncompressed (23884 bytes, no Content-Encoding) even though the client advertised gzip/br

results.title: Unexpected HTTP verbs are handled
results.steps: POST /Employee, DELETE /Employee/Create, PUT /Account/Login
results.expected: 404/405 rather than a server crash
results.actual: unexpected verbs handled without a 5xx: POST /Employee=200, DELETE /Employee/Create=200, PUT /Account/Login=200

results.title: robots.txt and sitemap.xml
results.steps: Request both files
results.expected: Served, or absent by design
results.actual: /robots.txt -> 404 (0 bytes); /sitemap.xml -> 404 (0 bytes)
notes: neither robots.txt nor sitemap.xml is served — acceptable for an internal app, but crawlers get no guidance for the public pages

results.title: No JavaScript errors on the main screens
results.steps: Watch the console on home, list and dashboard
results.expected: No console errors or unhandled exceptions
results.actual: no JavaScript errors on the home, list and dashboard screens

results.title: Search box retains the submitted term
results.steps: Search a name and re-read the input value
results.expected: The term stays in the box for refinement
results.actual: the search box retains 'BOyd' after submitting

results.title: Employee list at a 768px tablet viewport
results.steps: Open /Employee at 768×1024
results.expected: No horizontal overflow
results.actual: no horizontal overflow at 768px (doc 768px / win 768px)

results.title: Document language, title and heading structure
results.steps: Inspect html[lang], <title> and <h1> across the key pages
results.expected: Each page declares a language, a unique title and one h1
results.actual: document-level accessibility gaps: /Employee: no <h1> heading; duplicate page titles across screens: ['Sign In — EA Employee App']

results.title: Form controls are labelled and images have alt text
results.steps: Inspect the create/login/register forms and home page images
results.expected: Every control has a label; every image has alt text
results.actual: all form controls are labelled and images carry alt text

results.title: No test data left behind
results.steps: Search for every seeded prefix and delete what remains
results.expected: The database is left exactly as found
results.actual: no seeded test records left in the database
notes: the registered test account 'qarole0759338221' remains — the app offers no self-service account deletion
